description: This file defines the feature for creating comments within the app, including data models, validation, and request handling logic.

classes.name: CommentData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing the comment body.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the model and article slug for creating a comment.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Wrapper around CommentData for request payload structure.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the comment body is not empty.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a comment, associating it with an article and author, and saving to the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for the Comment body.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to create a comment for a specified article, with error handling for missing articles.
